title: Count after adding an index
statement: Let $kf:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and $t,j\in\mathbb{N}$. The number of indices $i<j+1$ with $kf(i)<t$ equals the number with $i<j$ satisfying that inequality, plus $1$ if $kf(j)<t$ and $0$ otherwise.
